reportedClaims.text: YC lists a 2025 founding and Spring 2025 batch.
The public YC launch seeks pilot partners; this is an invitation, not evidence of a completed pilot.
Founders, Inc. lists Tangible as founded in 2024 by Benjamin Soria, Bipasha Sen and Shankara Vaidyanathan.
mimic announced a $16 million seed round on 3 November 2025. This is a dated disclosure, not a verified current capitalization.
The July 2026 FLUX-mimic post reports testing and deployment work with Audi; operational results are company-reported.
YC currently marks K-Scale Labs inactive and lists former founders. The effective date and reason are not established.
Raion presents legged robot products and demonstrations using reinforcement-learning control; performance is company-reported.
Wayve’s current company page reports $2.8 billion total funding and links a $1.5 billion financing announcement. This is mature-company context, not an early-stage recommendation.
Waabi’s company page identifies Raquel Urtasun as founder and gives 2021 as its founding year.
Waabi’s news listing announces $1 billion in new funding on 28 January 2026. The aggregate is not classified here as a single equity round.
Helm.ai describes software for advanced driver assistance and autonomous driving, with global automaker partnerships. Product and partnership statements are company-reported.
World Labs presents Marble as a product for generating persistent 3D worlds. The page lists robotics among intended applications; this does not establish a robot deployment.
Genesis AI’s website presents Eno and says targeted customer deployments are planned by the end of 2026. This remains a plan.
Samsung Next reports participating in a $21.5 million financing round. Its retrieved page date is not sufficiently clear to assign an event date here.
Oxford Science Enterprises announced a $4.8 million pre-seed round for Stateful on 24 March 2026.
Oxford Science Enterprises reports live pilots in infrastructure and logistics; independent deployment outcomes were not checked.
Kinematic Trees announced £585,000 in pre-seed funding on 29 July 2026.
First customer factory deployment partnerships were planned for the second half of 2026. No completed deployment is established by this announcement.
YC lists Mbodi as founded in 2024 and part of Spring 2025.
The founders report an ABB commercialization agreement and movement toward customer deployments. The scope and outcomes remain company-reported.
Rerun announced a $17 million seed round led by Point Nine on March 20, 2025.
Rerun describes an open-source SDK and a commercial Hub for multimodal robotics data.
Foxglove announced a $40 million Series B led by Bessemer Venture Partners on November 11, 2025.
Foxglove says its platform captures, searches, visualizes and evaluates multimodal robotics data.
Zivid says it spun out of SINTEF in May 2015, founded by Henrik Schumann-Olsen and Øystein Skotheim.
Zivid lists the launch of its robot motion-planning software in March 2026.
BeyondMath announced a $10 million seed extension, bringing its seed round to $18.5 million, on February 25, 2026.
BeyondMath describes models trained on first-principles physics for engineering simulation.
BeyondMath reports participation in the three-year STRATA project with Honeywell; planned project benefits are not verified deployment results.
Neural Concept announced a $100 million Series C led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives on December 18, 2025.
Neural Concept describes physics- and geometry-aware models embedded in engineering design and simulation.
Emmi announced a €15 million seed round on April 25, 2025.
Emmi announced on May 19, 2026 that Mistral AI was acquiring it and its founding team would join Mistral’s Science and Applied AI teams.
Automata announced a $45 million Series C led by Dimension on January 29, 2026.
Automata describes modular robotics, orchestration software and shared data infrastructure for programmable laboratory workflows.
Automata reports repeat deployments and five major pharmaceutical customers; these are company-reported adoption claims.
Chemify’s news index lists an October 21, 2025 announcement of more than $50 million in Series B financing.
Chemify says it opened a Glasgow Chemifarm automated synthesis facility in 2025.
Radical AI announced a $55 million seed round on July 18, 2025.
Radical AI describes AI-generated experiments connected to its self-driving materials laboratory.
Radical AI reported an AFWERX contract for accelerated alloy discovery on August 25, 2025.
The team describes Instinct Edge, using distillation, quantization and device-specific runtimes for physical devices.
MorphoAI reports robot-design software and two paying OEM/integrator customers.
Almond describes the Axol dual-arm robot, an open-source SDK and data-collection tools.
Vision Lab announced a $6 million seed round led by Race Capital.
The company describes factory video linked to operating procedures and task context for training robotics models.
Eden describes robotic workers offered through hourly usage pricing for factories and warehouses.
Praxis describes hardware-assisted capture of industrial demonstrations and 3D scans for robotics datasets.
6thSense describes wearable rigs capturing contact, pressure and hand motion with visual and depth data for robot training.
Armatrix’s company timeline reports a $2.1 million pre-seed round led by pi Ventures in June 2025.
The company timeline reports a 3-metre robot-arm MVP in November 2025.
Armatrix describes reinforcement-learning-based autonomous navigation of its arm through complex geometry.
Cheng Chi’s profile says Sunday came out of stealth in November 2025.
YC lists b12 as founded in 2025 and part of Summer 2025.
The founders report paid pharmaceutical pilots on their YC profile. Customers and results have not been independently checked.
b12 describes Cobalt as generating instrument protocols for Chemspeed and Opentrons, alongside synthesis-planning and experimental-design tools.
YC lists a 2025 founding and Spring 2026 batch; the embedded launch text says W26, leaving a cohort-label discrepancy.
Synphony describes strawberry-picking robots and work with California growers. No independently verified deployment outcome is established.
YC lists a 2025 founding, Winter 2026 batch and Sydney company location.
Brumby’s FAQ describes ongoing testing and pilot-program rollout. Completed customer deployment is not established.
YC lists Red Barn as founded in 2023, in Winter 2025, and active in Seattle.
Red Barn describes Field Hand autonomous weeding and a robot-operated seasonal service. Customer results remain company-reported.
